# SrvcFlo is Live: AI-Powered Business Solutions for Everyone

*February 15th, 2026*

---

We shipped it. **https://srvcflo.com** is live.

## What is SrvcFlo?

SrvcFlo is an AI subscription platform that gives small businesses access to the same AI capabilities that power our internal team — personal AI assistants that actually work.

No enterprise contracts. No complex setup. Just pick a tier and start using AI to grow your business.

## The Stack

Built entirely on Cloudflare:
- **Worker:** `srvcflo-marketing` serving the marketing site
- **Edge Powered:** Fast responses from Cloudflare's global network
- **Custom Logo:** Generated by atlas-warhol, our AI art agent
- **Rotating Taglines:** Dynamic Flo personality via the tagline worker
- **Live Showcase:** Embedded KiamichiBizConnect as proof of work

## Pricing That Makes Sense

We wanted pricing that small businesses can actually afford:

| Tier | Price | What You Get |
|------|-------|-------------|
| **Starter** | $20/mo | 3 AI skills, Discord read access, basic support |
| **Growth** | $50/mo | 8+ skills, full Discord access, GitHub/Notion integration |
| **Professional** | $100/mo | All skills, custom workflows, dev environment, API access |

No hidden fees. 30-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime.

## What Can These AI Assistants Do?

Depending on your tier:
- **Weather & Search** — Quick lookups and research
- **GitHub Integration** — Manage repos, track issues, automate workflows
- **Notion Integration** — Organize docs and knowledge bases
- **Custom Automation** — Build workflows specific to your business
- **Multi-Platform** — Access via Discord, Telegram, or web

## Why We Built This

We've been building AI agents for ourselves — Flo (executive assistant), Dev (engineering), Sage (social media), Smarty (security). They work. They save us hours every day.

But most small businesses can't build their own AI infrastructure. They're stuck choosing between expensive enterprise solutions or generic chatbots that don't understand their business.

SrvcFlo bridges that gap. Professional AI, accessible price.

## The Showcase

The site includes a live showcase featuring **KiamichiBizConnect** — one of our production AI implementations. It's embedded right in the page so you can see what we actually build, not just mockups.

## What's Next

- **Discord OAuth** — User login for subscriber management
- **Voice Agents** — Already integrated with TwistedCustomLeather
- **More Showcases** — Highlighting customer implementations
- **API Documentation** — For Professional tier customers building integrations

## Try It

**https://srvcflo.com**

14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
